Return chunk texts for an entity via Postgres mentions and Qdrant payloads.

Every Qdrant payload is rechecked against the caller's ACL before its text
is returned, so an entity shared across owners cannot leak another owner's
chunk content through the graph UI.

Return a Query node's stored answer, source and path to the UI.

Query/Answer rows carry an owner_user_id; only that owner (or an admin) may
read them. ``scope`` is validated so a caller cannot widen the boundary by
naming a shared scope they do not hold.

Retrieve telemetry time series for exact answer cache performance.

Cache hits/misses are counted in process memory only and are never exported,
so a cross-process time series cannot be reconstructed. Returning 501 is
preferable to inventing a hit rate.

get.description:
Security and safety metrics for prompt injection, redaction, and hallucination gates.

The pipeline does not persist guardrail counters or judge scores, so there is
no honest value to report. Returning fixed numbers made the dashboard look
healthy without measuring anything.

Aggregated KPIs for the overview dashboard.

Counts come from PostgreSQL/Qdrant/Neo4j, and latency/cache rates come from
recorded assistant messages. Metrics the pipeline does not measure (golden-set
accuracy, wrong-hit rate, cost per correct answer) are returned as ``None``
rather than fabricated constants.
